headline: Infineon role targets centralized automation of analog and mixed-signal verification
fact: An Infineon job record for its central design-flow department in Dresden describes developing and integrating methods and software extensions for analog and mixed-signal verification automation, including SPICE simulation, reliability, optimization, and regression tooling. The role also lists AI/ML knowledge as an advantage. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof that a specific automated or AI-assisted flow was already deployed.

sources.title: Infineon: Staff Engineer Analog Verification Software (HRC0958244)
sources.summary: The official Infineon requisition lists a December 1, 2024 start date and describes the central design-flow role's verification-automation, tool, methodology, design-flow-integration, and AI/ML scope.
